scope: Prune redundant checkout files only. Keep the baseline commit reachable in ordinary Git history; do not rewrite history or remove the recovery source.

recovery.method: Read each path from baseline_commit with git show, or restore selected paths in a separate clone/worktree after resolving the baseline commit. Verify restored size and SHA-256 against this manifest.
recovery.per_file_identity: git_blob_sha1 is the exact baseline tree blob; sha256 is freshly hashed current content. All candidates are regular files and are unmodified in index and working tree.
recovery.before_execution: Recheck remote baseline ancestry and current file hashes. Remove only listed files; preserve any file that changed after this audit.

credential_scan.scope: 2418 tracked current paths plus 144 new nonignored candidate paths; 42 older-only reachable Git blobs scanned separately.
credential_scan.strict_patterns: GitHub/HuggingFace/OpenAI/Google OAuth/AWS token formats, private-key headers, long quoted credential assignments, credential-like filenames; values never printed.
credential_scan.limitations: Pattern audit is not proof that every possible secret encoding is absent.
